2 wounded inTurkish bombing on Afrin countryside

Two citizens were wounde in the Turkish occupation state and its mercenaries shelling on the village of Beina in the countryside of Sherawa district of Afrin and Shahba canton.

ANHA correspondent reported that the bombing of the Turkish occupation and its mercenaries on the village resulted in injury young man Ibrahim Berro and the citizen Arif Saeed Sheikh (48 years old) while they were working in the agricultural lands surrounding the village.

ANHA's pointed out that the people took them to Afrin Hospital in the village of Fafin in the Shahba area.
